title: When speech keeps outrunning wisdom as a steady practice
issueStatement: Words arrive before the heart has been cleaned enough to carry them well. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth.
actionPrompt: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Repeat what you can actually keep.
